geostatspy_source: PyPI geostatspy==0.0.79 (MIT), throw-away environment, not a BF dependency

cross_checks.kb3d_block_original_raises: IndexError: index 4 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 4

known_defects: geostatspy.kb2d 0.0.79 block mode (nxdis*nydis > 1) raises NameError 'real'; after that, the inner covariance loop of C_VV sums only the last j (if i == j and cbb += cov stand outside the j loop); references for blocks come from core/tests/reference/kb2d_fixed.py
geostatspy.kb3d 0.0.79 block mode: MAXDIS = nxdis*nydis ignores nzdis, 'real' is undefined, the same C_VV loop error; block kb3d is not frozen

geostatspy.kb3d 0.0.79 with nst = 2: setrot3D_array allocates rotmat inside the structure loop, the rotation matrix of structure 0 is zeroed and it acts as a constant covariance; the committed nst = 2 cases are computed with that single allocation moved before the loop (cross-checked with numpy)
geostatspy.kb3d 0.0.79 has no search radius: the two radii only set the vertical stretch rv / rh
geostatspy.kb2d / kb3d return the grids with row 0 = northernmost (and the top level first in 3D); the committed arrays are re-ordered to ascending Z, Y, X
geostatspy.setup_rotmat 0.0.79 uses PI = 3.14159265 (truncated): kb2d differs from an exact-pi calculation by up to ~6e-10 absolute (est and var); with the same truncated pi numpy agrees to 4e-15
geostatspy.kb2d 0.0.79 treats 'na' as a count after the kd-tree query, so `na == 0` (one-sample branch) means 'no sample'; the reference nodes all have >= 2 samples
